versions.content: {DRAFT} Upon reception of a SYNC (or OFS) message, if • Sequence Counter check is enabled (i.e., CanTSynGlobalTimeSequence- CounterJumpWidth > 0) • and the Time Domain is in timeout (i.e., TIMEOUT bit set in Time Base synchro- nization status timeBaseStatus ) • and the message is the first SYNC (or OFS) message in Timeout for which the Sequence Counter is not stuck, a Time Slave shall consider the Sequence Counter jump as valid.
